personality.description: This person tends to rely on familiar routines and proven methods, and they are usually cautious about adopting unfamiliar ideas or changing course without clear reasons. They keep an orderly but not rigid approach to daily tasks, adjusting when needed rather than insisting on strict rules. In moral dilemmas, they typically look for a practical compromise that protects relationships, showing strong empathy and a desire to avoid conflict while remaining steady and unruffled under pressure. In group discussions, they usually speak politely and considerately, listen carefully, and phrase disagreements gently so they can preserve harmony while still contributing their view.
traits: has assertively moved up the ranks into positions of leadership
prioritizes having control and authority over others
makes quick and definitive decisions, and once a decision is made it is usually final
has their own views of how tasks should be accomplished
uses reward and punishment to get people to follow their ideas
